import json,subprocess,sys,os,glob,collections
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r533'
d=json.load(open(L+'/results.json'))
assert d['346406']['prior_gate']=='NS'
d['346406']['prior_gate']='no search spent on this target'

for p in recs:
